description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - Amendment to the Medicines (Tender Pricing) Regulations - 2018, that Published in Gaz.Ex. No. 2086/37
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Minister under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, specifically amending tender pricing regulations for medicines. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements related to pharmaceutical pricing, without focusing on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio descriptions.
